title: Ottomans conquer Mamluk Egypt and Syria
place: Marj Dabiq, Syria and Cairo, Egypt
summary: The Ottoman Empire under Selim I defeated the Mamluk Sultanate, which had ruled from Egypt.
why: Brought Egypt, the Levant and the holy cities of the Hejaz under Ottoman rule.

notes.problem: Place too narrow: the decisive battle was Marj Dabiq in Syria (1516); Ridaniya was fought at the doorstep of Cairo (1517).
